description: Address 3 actionable code issues from review: (1) restore task state on project switch, (2) fix state mutation via .sort(), (3) prevent duplicate task creation for same card.
steps: In switchProject and cycleToProject, add setTasks(target.tasks || []), setTaskGroups(target.taskGroups || defaultGroups), setCardTaskLinks(target.cardTaskLinks || []) after setNextId.
In addTaskFromCard, replace taskGroups.sort(...) with [...taskGroups].sort(...) to avoid mutating React state.
In addTaskFromCard, add a guard at the top to check if cardTaskLinks already contains an entry for the given cardId, and return early if so.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds without errors
switchProject restores tasks, taskGroups, and cardTaskLinks from target project
cycleToProject restores tasks, taskGroups, and cardTaskLinks from target project
addTaskFromCard does not mutate taskGroups state array directly
addTaskFromCard returns early if a cardTaskLink already exists for the given cardId
verification: Run 'npm run build' in /projects/sandbox/mindmap5 and confirm exit code 0 with no errors
